highlightText: Type /help to get basic help.

Type /language list to check all the available languages.
Type /command regular to check the list of the regular-type commands.
Type /command fun to check the list of the fun-type commands.
Type /command cheat to check the list of the cheat-type commands.
Type /command manage to check the list of the management-type commands.
Type /voteoff all 1 to disable all live players' kickvotes for 1 day.
Type /unban, /unmute, or /voteon to remove your ban state (requires coins).
Check price of a command with /<command> access. E.g. /gloves access.
Type /myid to check your identities.
You can use locid to replace clientid for almost all transactions.
Convert your coin to score. Type /coin help.
Convert your score to coin. Type /stats help.
Try /tag help, /effect help, /pet help, /icon help, /symbol help.
Activate cheats automatically with /buff command.
Type /role add vip 1 to make yourself VIP for 1 month.
Always provide reason for admin commands, otherwise they will use your coins.
Reason consists of one or multiple words and is placed at the end of commands.
E.g. /end server error OR /kick <clientid> killing teammates.
Don't be AFK for too long. Press a button or get kicked by system.
Using admin commands without a valid reason will result in demotion.
Everyone is free to use any commands with coins.
